Container.Overview: Save hours every week with AI agents that handle repeatable work on your behalf—running on your own Unraid server and under your control. Tell AutoPilot what you want done or customize every step in the visual Builder, then run your agents on demand, on a schedule, or from a trigger. See Requirements for setup, memory, and first-account security guidance.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: AI agent agents LLM automation workflow no-code low-code chatbot copilot self-hosted OpenAI Anthropic GPT
Container.Requires: Experimental single-node distribution; not a high-availability deployment. Set Public URL to the exact origin used in the browser, including the selected host port. The WebUI shortcut uses the server IP over HTTP; when Public URL uses a hostname, HTTPS, or reverse proxy, open the configured URL directly. Enter the intended first account email. After signup, run docker exec AutoGPT autogpt-admin promote your-email@example.com, then edit this template and set Allow New Accounts to false. The workload has used approximately 5-6 GiB in testing; leave additional memory headroom for Unraid and other applications. To run against self-hosted models instead of a cloud provider, set the advanced Chat and Memory variables; the endpoint must serve both chat completions and embeddings, and search embeddings must be 1536-dimension. Support: https://github.com/Significant-Gravitas/autogpt-unraid/issues

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the AutoGPT web interface. The container port remains 3000.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent accounts, agents, databases, memory, workspaces, and generated secrets.

Config.Name: Public URL
Config.Description: Exact browser origin, for example http://192.168.1.10:3000. If this differs from the HTTP server-IP WebUI shortcut, open this configured URL directly.

Config.Name: First Account Email
Config.Description: Exact email address allowed to create the initial account.

Config.Name: Allow New Accounts
Config.Description: Leave true for first setup. Set false after creating and promoting the intended account.

Config.Name: Chat Use Local
Config.Description: Route AutoPilot chat at a self-hosted OpenAI-compatible endpoint instead of a cloud provider. Requires Chat Base URL and Chat API Key; the container refuses to start if either is missing.

Config.Name: Chat Base URL
Config.Description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible server, including the /v1 suffix. This single endpoint serves chat AND embeddings for every platform feature, so it must answer both /v1/chat/completions and /v1/embeddings.

Config.Name: Chat API Key
Config.Description: Bearer token sent to that endpoint. Self-hosted servers usually ignore the value, but it cannot be blank.

Config.Name: Chat Fast Model
Config.Description: Model id for quick turns, spelled exactly as the endpoint reports it in /v1/models.

Config.Name: Chat Thinking Model
Config.Description: Model id for reasoning-heavy turns. May be the same as the fast model.

Config.Name: Search Embedding Model
Config.Description: Embedding model for block, doc, and agent search. Must emit 1536-dimension vectors to match the pgvector column; a narrower model needs a proxy that pads them.

Config.Name: Memory LLM Base URL
Config.Description: Base URL for memory entity extraction, including the /v1 suffix. Extraction depends on enforced structured output: an endpoint that accepts a JSON schema and then ignores it fails validation on every episode.

Config.Name: Memory LLM Model
Config.Description: Model id used to extract entities and relationships from conversations.

Config.Name: Memory LLM API Key
Config.Description: Bearer token for the memory LLM. Falls back to Chat API Key when blank.

Config.Name: Memory Reranker Model
Config.Description: Model id for the cross-encoder that reranks retrieved memory. The prompts are simple classifiers, so the extraction model is a fine choice.

Config.Name: Memory Embedder Base URL
Config.Description: Base URL for memory embeddings, including the /v1 suffix. Kept separate from the search embedder because FalkorDB fixes this vector width when the graph is created and it cannot be changed afterwards.

Config.Name: Memory Embedder Model
Config.Description: Embedding model for memory. Any width works, provided it never changes for an existing graph.

Config.Name: Memory Embedder API Key
Config.Description: Bearer token for the memory embedder. Falls back to Chat API Key when blank.
